3. The learned Trial Judge having referred to as many as 21 challans made exhibits in the case showing deposit of rent subsequent to the initial deposit under section 19(1)(a) of the Ordinance ranging from the 8th to the 12th of each month found that the deposits were made beyond time, not having been made by the 7th of each month as was stipulated in the deed of lease. As a result he came to the conclusion that the petitioner was a defaulter, and decreed the suit 

 7. This being the clear legal positions all the deposits in question was well within time. The learned Small Cause Court Judge has, therefore, fallen into an error of law in decreeing the suit on the view that the petitioner was a defaulter in payment of rent 

 The Rule is, accordingly made absolute, the impugned judgment and decree are set aside and the suit is dismissed. No order is made as to costs.
